title: Write v2 copy to the research rules: a name, number or decision per sentence; limits only after the proof; AI as owned verification
body:
Rules from the 2026-10-26 research, on top of docs/02's voice rules:
- Every sentence carries a proper name, a number or a decision: 'Reemplacé el merge en feature-state por un índice hash en un Web Worker', not 'optimicé el rendimiento'. No adjectives about the person.
- Open each proof chapter with who needed what, before the skill.
- Numbers only from the dataset through formatMetric/formatMetricEnds (the '~'), never typed in; a TODO never becomes a headline.
- State facts plainly, no humblebrag. Limits (Inglés A2) go plainly and only AFTER the proof. On /en/, state A2 near the contact path: a polished English page implies a level an interview would contradict.
- AI is never the headline: frame it as owned verification ('Uso IA a diario; lo que entra al repo pasa por gates que escribí').
- One line of text per beat inside pinned scenes; longer explanation goes to the free-scroll chapters.
- Same facts in both languages: /en/ is direct, short and literal; / keeps the dataset's rioplatense voice.
- No 'hire me', no false scarcity, no skill bars, no logo wall, and no testimonials or services slot while those collections are empty.
- One CV label everywhere: 'Descargar CV' / 'Download CV'.
The hook sentence still fails the rarity test; the author writes it.
not_derivable: These came from the deleted research report; CLAUDE.md and docs/02 only carry the general voice test, not the placement and AI-framing rules.

evidence.summary: Copy-rules table of the 2026-10-26 personal-branding research report (signalling theory, humblebrag and pratfall studies, NN/g scrolljacking), since deleted.
